name: Diamond Holdings, Inc.
summary: Diamond Holdings, Inc. primarily concentrates on assessing and advancing nascent exploration prospects for vanadium and rare earth metals. A key holding for the company is its 100% ownership of the Desgrosbois vanadium-titanium property, which comprises 30 distinct mineral claims covering an expanse of 1,789 hectares in Quebec, Canada. The entity, which began operations as Venture Vanadium Inc., rebranded to Diamond Holdings, Inc. in August of 2021. Founded in 2016, the company's main office is located in Fairhope, Alabama.
